7. With regard to fixation of his pay on grant of promotion/financial upgradation under MACP Scheme, a Government servant has an option under FR 22 (I) (a) (1) to get his pay fixed in the higher post/Pay Level either from the date of his promotion/upgradation or from the date of his next increment viz. 1st July or 1st January, subiectto provisions in the Scheme.
